title: Atomic Energy Commission grant to Intelectron
place_text: Intelectron, Hell's Kitchen, New York City

tellings.quote: He gets a a grant for $300,000, which at the time would have been like at least a million dollars or more um from the Atomic Energy Commission,

plain: In the early 1960s, a scientist at Intelectron, a company in New York's Hell's Kitchen, is said to have received a $300,000 grant from the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency then in charge of nuclear work, which would be a million dollars or more today. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels this, drawing on the writer Annie Jacobsen and on the grant documents. He tells it to show that the scientist's work had serious government backing.
